_note: Location provenance for first-party DBF photographs. An image may only be presented as a specific named place when it appears here with evidence. Written 2026-09-07 after a real misattribution reached production: IMG_0943/IMG_0940 were published as Cape Henlopen on the strength of a filename and a prompt, and EXIF GPS on IMG_0940 (38.678158, -75.071000) placed them on Coastal Highway about a mile south of Dewey Beach — Delaware Seashore State Park, roughly 12 km from Cape Henlopen point.

_evidence_levels.gps: EXIF GPS coordinates read from the master file
_evidence_levels.landmark: an unmistakable, uniquely identifiable built landmark is in frame
_evidence_levels.sequence: adjacent frame in a timestamped burst whose location is established by gps or landmark
_evidence_levels.none: not established — must not carry a place claim
